say:1:1630343101:1.text: My daughter... she's studying at the Lyceum...
say:1:1630343101:1.source_cn: 我的孩子……她在莱希拉姆上学……
say:1:1630343101:1.male: My daughter... she's studying at the Lyceum...
say:1:1630343101:1.female: My daughter... she's studying at the Lyceum...

say:2:1630343102:1.text: She doesn't know... that I'm gone...
say:2:1630343102:1.source_cn: 她还不知道……我已经离开……
say:2:1630343102:1.male: She doesn't know... that I'm gone...
say:2:1630343102:1.female: She doesn't know... that I'm gone...

say:3:1630343103:1.text: I can't go yet... not until I see her, just once more...
say:3:1630343103:1.source_cn: 我得留下来……我还要看看她……我必须看看她……
say:3:1630343103:1.male: I can't go yet... not until I see her, just once more...
say:3:1630343103:1.female: I can't go yet... not until I see her, just once more...
